intro: The Scale of Old Murk-Eye is taken from the infamous murloc leader who terrorizes the coastline of Westfall. Severed from the beast's hide, it serves as undeniable proof of his demise for Captain Grayson, the ghost who haunts the Westfall Lighthouse.

p: The coast of Westfall is perilous enough between hidden shoals and relentless storms, but the presence of Old Murk-Eye elevated the danger from navigational hazard to outright massacre. According to Captain Grayson, the ghost bound to the Westfall Lighthouse, this particular murloc possessed a cunning beyond his feral kin, rallying weaker-minded murlocs to raid the shore. Murk-Eye scared off the keeper's family, leaving the beacon dark the night Grayson's ship smashed against the rocks, and when the family returned to relight the flame he raided again and slaughtered them. Taking a scale from the creature is the only way to satisfy the vengeful spirit and prove that the shore has been cleansed of its fiercest predator.
